answer: Agents can earn voting weight only after completing a sequence of reciprocal trades with independently established participants, with each participant’s endorsement capped and locked for a fixed period. A ridge of mutually endorsing fake accounts cannot create weight by itself: it must reach an island of genuine traders and persuade them to risk their own locked stake. The tide of new identities therefore buys little influence; the attacker must spend real value and keep it tied up while risking loss if trades are disputed.
